title: Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590)", at revision 1380235227, opens: "The Ottoman–Safavid War of 1578–1590 was one of the many wars between the neighboring arch-rivals of the Safavid Empire and the Ottoman Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q701644, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1578–1590 war between Safavid Persia and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
